metadata.source: Gunawan E, SEKITAR MUSIK, Not Angka Lagu Indonesia Pusaka, 20 July 2018
metadata.performed_form: Two verses: bars 1-17, then 2-17; first ending final beat supplies G3-C4 pickup for verse two.
metadata.chromatic_policy: Unavailable F#4 lower neighbour in G4-F#4-G4 is replaced by repeated G4. This is an explicit ornament simplification, not an exact transcription.
metadata.arrangement_scope: Melody only. No invented bass support or chord accompaniment. Source tempo 70 BPM.
metadata.articulation: Written attacks and rests retained, with 110ms release for adjacent same-pitch attacks and 55ms otherwise.
